This file guides Claude Code for this repository.

**CRITICAL**: This project uses **UV** for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.

Commands:
```sh
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
make dev
make verify
make test
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint
make format
make doctor
make build-plugin
make sync-plugin-repo
make clean
```

**⚠️ IMPORTANT**: The `.claude-plugin/` directory and TypeScript plugin system described in older docs **DO NOT EXIST** in v4.1.9. This is planned for v5.0 (see [issue #419](https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework/issues/419)).

**Current v4.1.9 Architecture**: Python package with slash commands:
- `settings.json`, `commands/` (installed via `superclaude install`)
- `src/superclaude/`: `pytest_plugin.py`, `pm_agent/` (`confidence.py`, `self_check.py`, `reflexion.py`), `execution/` (`parallel.py`, `reflection.py`, `self_correction.py`), `cli/` (`main.py`, `doctor.py`, `install_skill.py`)
- `plugins/superclaude/`: Future plugin source (**NOT ACTIVE**)
- `tests/`, `scripts/`, `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`

Registered via `pyproject.toml` entry point, automatically available after installation.

Fixtures: `confidence_checker`, `self_check_protocol`, `reflexion_pattern`, `token_budget`, `pm_context`. Unit tests → `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.unit`; integration tests → `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.integration`. Markers: `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.confidence_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.self_check`, `<REDACTED_USER>.mark.reflexion`.

ConfidenceChecker requires ≥90%; 70–89% present alternatives; <70% ask questions. SelfCheckProtocol validates post-implementation with evidence; no speculation—verify tests/docs. ReflexionPattern records errors and matches cross-session patterns. Use **Wave → Checkpoint → Wave** (`src/superclaude/execution/parallel.py`): `[Read files in parallel]` → Analyze → `[Edit files in parallel]`.

**⚠️ NOT IMPLEMENTED**: The TypeScript plugin system described below does not exist in v4.1.9. This is planned for v5.0. See [issue #419](https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework/issues/419) and `docs/plugin-reorg.md`.

**Current v4.1.9 Commands** (slash commands, not plugins):
`pipx install superclaude && superclaude install`; installed to `~/.claude/commands/`; `/pm`, `/research`, `/index-repo` (and others).

**Never guess** - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation. Check confidence BEFORE starting: ≥90% proceed, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions. Always prefer MCP tools over speculation for documentation/research. MCP: airis-mcp-gateway, Tavily, Context7, Sequential, Serena, Mindbase; optional Playwright, Magic, Chrome DevTools.

Branching: `master` ← `integration` ← `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`.
1. `git checkout -b feature/your-feature`
2. `uv run pytest`
3. `git commit -m "feat: description"`
4. Merge to `integration`, validate, then `master`.

**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
```sh
cd ~/github/SuperClaude_Framework
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent
git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration
```
Use separate sessions/directories; never switch conflicting branches.

Read `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`, and docs in `docs/user-guide/`, `docs/developer-guide/`, `docs/reference/`.

Budgets: simple 200, medium 1,000, complex 2,500 tokens. Confidence ROI: spend 100–200 to save 5,000–50,000.

Install:
```sh
pipx install superclaude
git clone https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework.git
cd SuperClaude_Framework
```

**What Does NOT Work** (yet):
❌ `.claude-plugin/` directory auto-detection
❌ `/plugin marketplace add` commands
❌ `/plugin install superclaude`
❌ `make build-plugin` (planned but not functional)
❌ Project-local plugin detection

Package: `superclaude`; build: hatchling (PEP 517); CLI: `superclaude`; pytest plugin: auto-loaded as `superclaude`.
